abilities.name: Shell Ear
abilities.description: Hear an incoming shell's whistle and you can sense where it will land a second before it does.
abilities.cost: Every shell after leaves your ears ringing

abilities.name: Dig In
abilities.description: With a shovel and ten minutes you can make a hole that shields you from rifle fire.
abilities.cost: Hands blistered; the next dig is slower

abilities.name: Field Dressing
abilities.description: Bind a wound under fire so the soldier can keep moving until the medics arrive.
abilities.cost: Uses a bandage; leaves you exposed while you work

growth.grows: how bad a wound you can bind

abilities.name: Steady Aim
abilities.description: Hold your breath and your rifle stays still for one shot, even with your hands shaking.
abilities.cost: Only one shot per held breath

growth.grows: how far and how steady the shot

abilities.name: Officer's Voice
abilities.description: Shout an order and frightened soldiers around you obey it before thinking, for one command.
abilities.cost: Hoarse; officers do not like privates who do this

growth.grows: how many soldiers and how panicked

abilities.name: Ration Fixer
abilities.description: Swap your rations or cigarettes with other units for what you need, if they have it to spare.
abilities.cost: You go without what you gave away

growth.grows: how rare a thing you can find

abilities.name: Gas Nose
abilities.description: Smell gas a few seconds before others, in time to get your mask on.
abilities.cost: Headaches every time the wind turns

growth.grows: how faint a trace and how early

abilities.name: Mud Crawl
abilities.description: When you crawl through mud and wire at night, you stay unseen by sentries until a flare goes up.
abilities.cost: Cold and soaked; the cuts from the wire can fester

growth.grows: how close to the enemy you can crawl

abilities.name: Lucky Charm
abilities.description: Hold a charm from home before an attack and you can ignore one wound until the fight ends.
abilities.cost: Lose the charm and the luck turns against you

growth.grows: how many wounds it holds off

abilities.name: Map Reading Under Fire
abilities.description: Read a field map by match light and know the way back to your own lines.
abilities.cost: The match light can give you away

growth.grows: how bad a map you can still use

abilities.name: Second Breath March
abilities.description: After a full day's march you can push on for one more hour at full pace.
abilities.cost: You sleep through the next watch and cannot be woken easily

abilities.name: Bayonet Drill
abilities.description: When an enemy closes to blade range, you can parry their first thrust without thinking.
abilities.cost: Only the first thrust; the drill leaves you open after

growth.grows: how many thrusts and how skilled a foe
